title: Niagara-on-the-Lake Wine Tour with Lunch -Private Tour in Classic English Cab
includes: Pick up on US side (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Explore the wonderful wines of Niagara-on-the-Lake, Ontario, Canada on this 5.5-hour tour to four separate wineries. Enjoy tastings of three or four wines at each stop and a delicious Picnic lunch along your way. Learn about the winemaking process and the wines themselves, while trying to discover each wine’s unique tasting notes. Enjoying Niagara On The Lake's country side from the comfort of you very own Authentic Classic English Cab
